source_snapshot.procedure: Generic setup says clear logs; open Dashboard and Server Health > Sensor Reading.
source_snapshot.criteria: Sensor reading and threshold are human readable and match specification.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES may read the label but truncates fallback inventory and cannot prove the exact switch silicon/board reference, PCIe topology, BMC source, die-versus-board field or complete UI/spec agreement.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION identifies a platform-specific PCIe switch sensor and requires topology mapping and complete UI/spec evidence.

old_problem: A named temperature could be accepted without identifying which PCIe switch instance it represents or whether the measurement is on-die/package or a nearby board sensor. Generic link status, GPU temperature, another switch, one BDF or truncated inventory could falsely satisfy the row, and PCIe exercise could be introduced without authority.
disposition_reason: Bind the stable PEX_SW record and both UI rows to the exact switch silicon, part/firmware/reference designator, stable BDF and full upstream/downstream topology plus BMC controller/bus/mux/address field. Compare complete evidence with measurement-specific switch limits under the existing passive link/load/cooling state; topology and limits are Project parameters.
decision_basis: XLSX row 891, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2, internal Script reference, selection manifest, related source cases and historical record were directly reviewed.
PEX_SW strongly suggests a PCIe switch but does not identify the instance or prove that the value is the switch die rather than a board-local sensor.
PCIe enumeration/link state can corroborate topology but cannot replace the BMC sensor field or thermal acceptance.
ED-15 requires measurement-specific limits, ED-17 preserves AER/XID/thermal logs and ED-14 keeps dynamic threshold and PCIe functional behavior separate.

test_case.test_name: Verify TEMP_GB_PEX_SW against the exact PCIe switch instance, topology and BMC measurement field
test_case.purpose: Verify TEMP_GB_PEX_SW is the intended GPU-baseboard PCIe switch record, maps to the exact switch instance and BMC die/package/board field, and is human readable in Dashboard and Server Health with correct value, units, health, implemented thresholds/hysteresis and freshness under the recorded passive link/load/cooling state.
required_package: Chassis/GPU-baseboard PN/revision, BMC/BIOS and authoritative PEX_SW terminology
Switch vendor/device/part/revision/serial/firmware, board reference designator and physical location
Stable BDF and complete upstream/downstream topology to root port, switch ports and GPU/NVSwitch endpoints
BMC controller/bus/mux/address and exact die, package or nearby-board temperature field
Stable SDR/API and Dashboard/Server Health identities
Field-specific units/scaling, approved range/delta, threshold capability/values/hysteresis, health, polling/freshness and unavailable rules
Recorded host/GPU power/load, link speed/width/state, fan speeds and baseboard airflow
Validated protected OOB/API/browser clients and pinned immutable reviewed `sensor.git` revision/checksum or approved manual read-only method
test_case.test_command: Do not clear SEL/kernel/AER/GPU XID/PCIe/thermal logs, generate traffic, retrain/reset/reconfigure links, change ASPM/speed/power, service hardware, alter fans/airflow/thresholds or flash switch firmware. Confirm the exact switch and BMC measurement point from schematic/topology. Resolve one stable TEMP_GB_PEX_SW identity from the complete repository; review the Script before use. Capture complete identity, value, units, capability/threshold/hysteresis, health and timestamp plus unchanged Dashboard and Server Health rows. Record passive switch/link/load/cooling state and compare only with the approved field-specific specification. Stop without retry on identity, source, stale or UI/OOB/topology divergence.
test_case.expected_result: One stable record and both UI rows map to the documented physical PCIe switch, topology and exact BMC die/package/board field. Complete OOB/UI value, units, thresholds, health and freshness match switch/field-specific limits under the recorded passive state. GPU temperature, generic link status, another switch or neighboring board sensor never substitutes and PCIe state remains unchanged.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact switch/topology/source identity, complete OOB and both-UI agreement, field-specific specification and engineer verdict. Label existence, one BDF, link health, GPU temperature, plausible value, truncated output or command success alone cannot pass. Wrong/stale identity, out-of-limit value or required threshold/status/UI mismatch is FAIL. Missing switch/source/spec/reviewed method is NOT READY, not Pending or PASS; PCIe integrity, traffic, retraining, firmware and dynamic threshold behavior are outside scope.
safety_gate: Do not clear SEL, kernel/AER, GPU XID, PCIe or thermal logs; switch-health context must be preserved.
Do not accept the label alone; prove exact switch instance, board reference and die/package/board measurement point.
Do not infer complete topology from one BDF or replace the BMC field with link/enumeration evidence.
Do not generate traffic, retrain/reset/reconfigure links, alter ASPM/speed/power, service hardware, cooling or thresholds, or flash firmware.
Vendor telemetry may corroborate only after exact switch and field equivalence is approved.
Do not truncate output, expose credentials or run an unreviewed Script; no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Chassis/GPU-baseboard PN/revision, BMC/BIOS and exact switch vendor/device/part/revision/serial/firmware/reference-designator identity
Stable BDF and complete upstream/downstream topology plus BMC controller/bus/mux/address and exact temperature-field source
Complete stable raw identity, value, units, threshold capabilities/values, health and timestamp plus separate Dashboard and Server Health rows
Switch/field-specific specification and recorded host/GPU power/load, link speed/width/state, fan/baseboard airflow with any approved equivalent telemetry
Stale/divergent disposition and pinned Script or alternate-method audit
No-clear/no-traffic/no-retrain-or-reset/no-service/no-retry proof, final PCIe/GPU/BMC health and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: No mutation is expected. On switch, topology or measurement-field ambiguity, stale/divergent data or unexpected PCIe/GPU/BMC health change, stop and preserve the first complete evidence plus link/topology state. Use approved read-only BMC/PCIe diagnostics; do not retrain, reset or service the switch to force evidence. Any independently authorized PCIe action requires its own recovery plan.
